summary: The large Ankh3 model; a next-generation Ankh trained with multi-task denoising plus sequence completion, showing that sequence-only multi-task pretraining can rival multimodal models.
architecture: T5-style encoder–decoder (Ankh line); 1536-dim per-residue encoder embeddings. Uses task-prefix conditioning for representation vs. generation.
pretraining_objective: Joint multi-task pretraining: masked language modeling at multiple masking probabilities plus protein sequence completion (sequence-only).
key_innovations: Shows unimodal, sequence-only multi-task design can match or surpass multimodal PLMs on downstream tasks
when_to_use: When you want a recent, sequence-only model with strong reported downstream performance at a 1536-dim embedding size.
caveats: Very recent (2025); exact parameter counts and training details are thin in public sources; verify before quoting specifics.

citations.title: Ankh3: Multi-Task Pretraining with Sequence Denoising and Completion Enhances Protein Representations
